title: Chief Risk Officer (CRO)
summary: A chief risk officer leads all risk management in a bank, NBFC, insurer or large fintech. They set the risk appetite with the board, oversee credit, market, operational, fraud and cyber risk, challenge risky business decisions, and report to the board's risk management committee. RBI requires larger NBFCs and banks to have an independent CRO.
dailyDuties: Set and monitor the risk appetite and limits with the board
Review large credit decisions and portfolio trends
Oversee operational, fraud, cyber and market risk teams
Report to the board risk management committee
Handle RBI inspections, ICAAP and stress tests
Challenge new products and growth plans on risk

skills.expectation: Run the enterprise risk framework and risk appetite
Oversee credit risk measurement and portfolio limits
Meet RBI rules on risk management, capital and the CRO role
Watch portfolio quality, concentration and early warnings
Report to the board risk management committee
Lead the credit, market, operational and fraud risk teams
Challenge the CEO and business heads on risk-taking
Oversee market and liquidity risk where the firm trades
Bring cyber risk into the enterprise view
Read the firm's and borrowers' financials
